title: Disinfection
description: Ozonation provides deep disinfection of premises and transport, destroying bacteria, viruses, fungi and spores without chemical residues. The gas penetrates all hard-to-reach areas.

shopping-malls.title: Shopping malls
shopping-malls.content:
Shopping malls are high-traffic spaces with dense visitor flow. Ozonation maintains air quality, removes odors and helps prevent infection spread.

Regular ozone treatment during off-hours disinfects all surfaces: escalators, handrails, elevators, benches, restrooms. The gas reaches all areas, including back-of-house and technical zones.

Ozone effectively removes odors from food courts, restrooms and storage areas. It neutralizes chemical pollutants from finishes and merchandise. The air becomes fresh and pleasant for visitors.

Large malls use high-capacity industrial ozone generators or systems integrated with ventilation. Treatment is automated with timers and sensors.

intro.paragraph1: Shopping malls are places of mass gatherings with intense visitor flow. Thousands of people touch the same surfaces daily: escalators, handrails, elevator buttons, door handles. Ozonation maintains air quality, eliminates odors and provides infection prevention.
intro.paragraph2: Regular ozone treatment during off-hours disinfects all surfaces, including hard-to-reach areas and technical zones. The gas penetrates all rooms, ensuring comprehensive treatment of the entire facility.

comfort.label: Visitor comfort
comfort.text: directly affects time spent in the mall and purchase volume. Clean fresh air without foreign odors is an important element of a positive shopping experience.

zones.title: Treatment zones in shopping malls
items: Shopping galleries and atriums — main visitor gathering areas
Escalators and elevators — contact surfaces with maximum load
Food courts — sources of odors and food contamination
Storage and technical rooms — often ignored during cleaning
Ventilation systems — distribute air throughout the mall
Parking lots — accumulate exhaust fumes and odors

odorProblem.title: Odor problem in malls
odorProblem.intro: Shopping malls combine many odor sources: food courts, restrooms, perfume stores, storage areas. Ozone effectively neutralizes all these odors, not masking them, but destroying the molecules of odorous substances.

night.title: Night treatment
night.description: Mobile ozone generators treat the mall after closing. Maximum effectiveness.

ventilation.title: Ventilation integration
ventilation.description: Duct ozone generators in HVAC system. Continuous air quality maintenance.

zonal.title: Zonal treatment
zonal.description: Wall-mounted ozone generators in problem zones: restrooms, food court, parking.

combined.title: Combined approach
combined.description: Combination of all methods for maximum effect

steps.title: Night disinfection
steps.description: After mall closing, mobile ozone generators are started. Treatment 2-4 hours depending on area. By opening, ozone completely decomposes.

steps.title: Food court
steps.description: Daily treatment after cafes close. Elimination of cooking odors, disinfection of tables and chairs.

steps.title: Restrooms
steps.description: Low-power ozone generators work continuously at safe concentration or turn on automatically during breaks.

steps.title: Ventilation
steps.description: Duct ozone generators supply ozone to air ducts, ensuring supply air disinfection.

equipment.title: Equipment calculation
equipment.highlight: For large shopping malls, comprehensive ozonation system design is recommended, taking into account building architecture, ventilation systems and operating mode. We develop custom solutions.

safety.title: Visitor safety
safety.description: Reduced risk of infection spread in crowded areas

comfort.title: Comfortable atmosphere
comfort.description: Clean air without odors increases visitor stay time

compliance.title: Regulatory compliance
compliance.description: Meeting sanitary requirements for public places

savings.title: Chemical savings
savings.description: Reduced costs for disinfectants and air fresheners

safety.title: Safety for visitors
safety.intro: With proper organization, ozonation is absolutely safe for visitors and shopping mall staff.
items: Main treatment — at night when the mall is closed
Restrooms — automatic shutdown when visitors enter
Concentration sensors — real-time ozone level monitoring
By opening, ozone completely decomposes into oxygen
safety.warning: MPC of ozone for work zone — 0.1 mg/m³. With ventilation integration, concentration is maintained at 0.03-0.05 mg/m³ — this is safe and provides a 'fresh air' effect.
